chapters.title: He's tearing through the brush behind me.
I take a few steps back.
Slicing rain stings my skin like a thousand tiny knives.
He hauls me up by my arm...
I swallow the panic along with the rain and keep running.
I can't let him find me.
I kick at the hand at my ankle and realize it's just a twisting root.
I hear the cocking of the gun.
My head bounces against his shoulder as he carries me through the storm.
I feel his hands around my neck.
The sound of his voice makes me wish the mud would hurry up and do its job.
I let him carry me all the way back to the boardwalk.
My chest aches and I can't scream anymore...
He squats down next to me.
I'm waiting for the bullet to split my skull in half.
I let go of the boardwalk...
I yell his name as loud as I can.
That's when I know for sure.
